sources.title: BLS Public Data API (Version 2.0): registration, limits, series access, Terms of Service
sources.data_provided: Programmatic access (JSON) to BLS time series including OEWS (OE), ECEC (CM), ECI (CI), PPI (WP/PC) series. Registered use adds calculations, annual averages, catalog metadata.
sources.edition: Version 2.0 (Version 1.0 is unregistered with lower limits)
sources.access_notes: Registration page https://data.bls.gov/registrationEngine/ (email + organization, CAPTCHA, key emailed from labstat@bls.gov per FAQ snippet); registration must be renewed at least annually. Key goes in a registrationkey field in the JSON payload or as a URL parameter. The POST endpoint URL itself was not visible in results (believed https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/ - prior_knowledge_unverified). Docs seen: https://www.bls.gov/developers/api_faqs.htm, https://www.bls.gov/developers/api_signature_v2.htm, https://www.bls.gov/developers/termsOfService.htm. One older page (https://www.bls.gov/bls/api_features.htm) still says no registration is needed; that text appears stale versus the FAQ.
sources.reuse_terms: Per search snippet of the Terms of Service: users must cite the date they accessed data through the API; must not misrepresent modified content as BLS data; BLS may block accounts that try to exceed or circumvent limits.
sources.limitations: Limits: v2 500 queries/day, 50 series/query, 20 years/query; v1 25 queries, 25 series, 10 years; 50 requests per 10 seconds (all per FAQ snippet). Not a bulk-file channel for all OEWS occupations x areas (series count would exceed daily capacity); use XLSX/ZIP release files for bulk.
sources.update_frequency: Real time with each BLS release
sources.evidence_quote: The official BLS FAQ confirms your figures for registered Version 2.0 access: 500 queries per day, 50 series per query, and 20 years per query. Unregistered Version 1.0 access is 25 queries, 25 series, and 10 years.
sources.notes:
Obtained through a web-search result summary; the primary page could not be fetched from the build environment (network policy). Not eligible for 'validated' until the primary document is read.
CORRECTION (reviewer F1): this entry and SRC-BLS-PUBLIC-DATA-API describe the same BLS API FAQ page. The registry keeps both for traceability; the effective terms are the more cautious of the two until a person reads https://www.bls.gov/developers/api_faqs.htm.

sources.limitations: Prevailing wage applies to public works (and other covered work) - it is a union-scale-driven legal minimum, not the market wage of a non-union crew and not a total loaded cost. Travel and subsistence is governed separately (Labor Code 1773.1, 1773.9 per boilerplate) and is not a single published figure in the determination. Consumer must apply the correct area, effective date and increase tables.
sources.update_frequency: Twice a year (issued February 22 and August 22 per DIR FAQ snippet), effective 10 days after issuance, plus ad hoc modification/correction notices and predetermined increases
